description.value:
Duration constant

Whatever was going to fix them is not going to fix them in this room.

A creature within hazardous ground you created cannot regain Hit Points from any source, and any regeneration or fast healing it has is suppressed. The moment it leaves, healing works normally again — which is the part that makes people leave.

cinderfall.incomplete: suppresses a DIFFERENT creature's own healing. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
